gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Noto Sans Tai Le reads approachably, its strokes tapering off before they touch and its capitals barely rising above the lowercase. Galaxy's unbroken line width gives the pair its spine.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Noto Sans Tai Tham packs its lowercase tight up toward the capital line, leaving each c clearly open to the eye. Galaxy hums above, smooth and featureless, while the lowercase handles detail.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Galaxy's lines hold a ruler-straight weight from end to end. Beneath it, Noto Sans Tai Viet keeps short ascenders and a tall x-height, its terminals pulled back from each curve's close.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-takri: Noto Sans Takri reads openly, with every small round letter left generously unclosed and a high-waisted lowercase. Galaxy's total lack of thick-thin swing is what sets the pair apart.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Magnified without growing, the text stops its terminals far from the stem beneath Galaxy's monoline heading. Noto Sans Tamil takes the quieter role while the heading carries the volume.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-tamil-sup: Engraved cosmos up top: Galaxy cuts every line to one depth, while Noto Sans Tamil Supplement bends round like open parentheses. That stocky, tall middle band is the body's real signature.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Noto Sans Tangsa welcomes the eye with generous round openings and short ascender stems. Galaxy earns its keep big and brief, where its curves and stems move in tight lockstep.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-tc: Cosmic from the first letter, Galaxy holds a pressure-free line with no brush swell anywhere. Noto Sans TC follows with tall, spacious letter shapes whose curves open outward rather than curling in.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Galaxy lands hard and smooth, its joints meeting without any thinning or bulging. And Noto Sans Telugu, with its high midline and counters open to the outside, would read smoothly page after page.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Smooth as tubing, Galaxy gives each line a rounded, tube-like look. Noto Sans Thaana sits beneath with wide channels into big lowercase forms, giving the heading room to stand out.
